[font=Tahoma][size=4][b]Install[/b][/size][/font]
[list=1]
[*][size=2]Download with Content Patcher.[/size]
[*][size=2]Unzip the mod folder into [i]Stardew Valley/Mods[/i].[/size]
[*][size=2]Run the game using SMAPI.[/size]
[/list]
[b][size=4][font=Tahoma]How to use[/font]
[/size][/b][size=2][list]
[*][size=2]Vanilla male marriage candidates(Alex, Elliott, Harvey, Sam, Sebastian, and Shane) can be purchased from the Traveling Cart. [/size]
[/list][/size][b][color=#f4cccc][left] ﻿Their frame is only sold if you're married to them.[/left][/color][/b][size=2][list]
[*][size=2]Linus’s portrait can be purchased at Robin’s shop, regardless of marriage status.[/size]
[/list][/size]
[b][size=4][font=Tahoma]Next Update[/font]
[/size][/b][size=2][list]
[*][size=2]Linus’s frame will later be updated to match the other male spouses: [/size]
[*]it will only appear in the Traveling Cart if you’re married to him. (Marriage expansion compatibility)
[/list][/size]
